import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
import pickle

# Parse the XML content from the web_fetch result
xml_content = result['content']
root = ET.fromstring(xml_content)
ns = {
    'atom': 'http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom',
    'arxiv': 'http://arxiv.org/schemas/atom'
}

papers = []
for entry in root.findall('atom:entry', ns):
    # Extract basic info
    paper_id = entry.find('atom:id', ns).text
    title = entry.find('atom:title', ns).text.strip()
    summary = entry.find('atom:summary', ns).text.strip()
    published = entry.find('atom:published', ns).text
    
    # Extract authors
    authors = []
    for author in entry.findall('atom:author', ns):
        name = author.find('atom:name', ns).text
        authors.append(name)
    
    # Extract categories
    categories = []
    for category in entry.findall('atom:category', ns):
        categories.append(category.get('term'))
    
    # Extract links (HTML and PDF)
    links = {}
    for link in entry.findall('atom:link', ns):
        rel = link.get('rel')
        href = link.get('href')
        if rel == 'alternate':
            links['html'] = href
        elif rel == 'related' and link.get('title') == 'pdf':
            links['pdf'] = href
    
    papers.append({
        'id': paper_id,
        'title': title,
        'summary': summary,
        'published': published,
        'authors': authors,
        'categories': categories,
        'links': links
    })

print(f"Found {len(papers)} papers")
for i, p in enumerate(papers):
    print(f"\n--- Paper {i+1} ---")
    print(f"Title: {p['title']}")
    print(f"Authors: {', '.join(p['authors'])}")
    print(f"Published: {p['published']}")
    print(f"Summary: {p['summary'][:200]}...")

# Save to file for next step
with open('/tmp/papers.pkl', 'wb') as f:
    pickle.dump(papers, f)
